metadata.note: Security-only report (AppCAT assessment was not run — MCP tools not available in this environment)

security.title: Java: DoS Vulnerability in JSON-JAVA
security.description: A denial of service vulnerability in JSON-Java. A bug in the parser means that an input string of modest size can lead to indefinite amounts of memory being used.

evidence.explanation:
[CVE-2023-5072](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4jq9-2xhw-jpx7): Java: DoS Vulnerability in JSON-JAVA

Severity: HIGH

Affected: org.json:json:20140107 (build.gradle:17)

Recommended fix: Upgrade to 20231013 or later

security.title: json stack overflow vulnerability
security.description: A stack overflow in the XML.toJSONObject component of org.json:json before version 20230227 allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via crafted JSON or XML data.

evidence.explanation:
[CVE-2022-45688](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3vqj-43w4-2q58): json stack overflow vulnerability

Severity: HIGH

Affected: org.json:json:20140107 (build.gradle:17)

Recommended fix: Upgrade to 20230227 or later

security.title: Use of Obsolete Function
security.description: The code uses deprecated or obsolete functions, which suggests that the code has not been actively reviewed or maintained.

evidence.explanation: Class.forName() used for JDBC driver loading at InterestConnectionFactory.java:10 — obsolete since JDBC 4.0

security.title: Data Access Operations Outside of Expected Data Manager Component
security.description: The product uses a dedicated, central data manager component as required by design, but it contains code that performs data-access operations that do not use this data manager.

evidence.explanation: Direct SQL operations embedded in servlet classes without a dedicated DAO/repository layer

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: Hard-coded database password in interest.properties:5, used by InterestConnectionFactory for SQL Server authentication

security.title: Insufficient Logging
security.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

evidence.explanation: No logging framework used; financial operations and errors are not logged

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
security.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

evidence.explanation: Hard-coded SA username and password in interest.properties (lines 4-5), used for SQL Server database access with administrator privileges

properties.description: Interest calculation service for ZavaBank using Java Servlets and SQL Server
